_note: Feature catalog for the demo pipeline. Features are the reusable ATOMS — video-agnostic. compositions.json selects and orders them into specific videos. Capture films each `captured: true` feature once (keyed by capture.frame / capture.events); render resolves a composition against this catalog. `context` is the analytical core: `ring` drives section grouping, `symbolKinds` proves the 'not just ref()' thesis, `differentiator` (beyond-LSP) drives teaser selection, `pitch`/`pain` are the marketing-copy + caption source.

rings.blurb: The statement under your cursor — the editor already understands it.

rings.title: The current file
rings.blurb: Comprehend the whole file you're in.

rings.title: The data

context.pitch: Cursor inside a {% if %}, a loop, or a macro — hover, completion, go-to-def and diagnostics all keep working. We parse the SQL through the Jinja, not around it.
context.pain: Most SQL tooling treats Jinja as noise and breaks the moment it hits a {% %} block.

render.caption: Jinja ninja — hover, completion, and go-to-def keep working inside {% if %} blocks and macros.

context.pitch: See a model without opening it — preview, columns, and docs inline on the ref().
context.pain: Following a ref() means leaving your file and losing your place.

render.caption: Hover a ref() — model preview, columns, docs. Without opening a single file.

context.pitch: Point at any column and see where its value actually comes from — traced through CTEs and refs.
context.pain: You inherit a 400-line model and have no idea where a column originates.

render.caption: Hover a column — see exactly where it comes from, through refs and CTEs.

context.pitch: Your whole model catalog and their columns, autocompleted inside ref() and SELECT.
context.pain: Model and column names are guesswork you verify by grepping the repo.

render.caption: Completions — your whole model catalog, autocompleted inside ref().

context.pitch: Broken ref() and unknown columns flagged in the editor, before you save.
context.pain: A typo'd ref() only surfaces as a red dbt run in CI, minutes later.

render.caption: Diagnostics — broken ref() caught before you hit save. No surprises in CI.

context.pitch: Run · Test · Compile · Query · Profile · Lineage — one click above every model. No terminal.
context.pain: Every dbt action is a context switch to a terminal and a remembered command.

render.caption: Editor buttons — Lineage · Run · Test · Compile · Query · Profile. No terminal needed.

context.pitch: The whole file as an outline — every CTE and its columns. Jump without scrolling.
context.pain: Navigating a long model means scrolling and Ctrl-F for the CTE you want.

render.caption: Document Outline — every CTE and its columns. Navigate without scrolling.

context.pitch: Ctrl+Click any ref(), CTE, or column and land on its definition — across files.
context.pain: Finding where something is defined is a manual file hunt.

render.caption: Go to Definition — Ctrl+Click any ref() and land in that model. Instantly.

context.pitch: Every place a model or column is used, across the whole project.
context.pain: Before you change a column you have no safe way to see who depends on it.

render.caption: Find All References — see everywhere this model is used across the project.

context.pitch: Every model that calls this one, and every model it calls — walk it both ways.
context.pain: The DAG around a model is invisible from inside the file.

render.caption: Call Hierarchy — every model that calls this one, and every model it calls. Toggle both ways.

context.pitch: F2 on a model, CTE, column, or alias and every reference updates project-wide.
context.pain: Renaming means find-and-replace and praying you didn't miss a usage.

render.caption: Rename — press F2, every reference updates. Models, CTEs, columns, aliases.

context.pitch: Ctrl+T to fuzzy-jump to any model or source. No file browsing.
context.pain: Opening the right model means digging through the folder tree.

render.caption: Ctrl+T — fuzzy jump to any model or source in the project. No file browsing.

context.pitch: Your whole project — models, sources, tags — in one browsable tree.
context.pain: The project's shape lives only in your head and the folder structure.

render.caption: Model Explorer — models, sources, tags. Your whole project, right there.

context.pitch: An interactive DAG that follows your editor, down to column-level traces.
context.pain: dbt docs' lineage is static and disconnected from where you're working.

render.caption: Lineage — interactive DAG that follows your editor. Drill into column-level traces.

context.pitch: Press F5 — Jinja compiles, the query runs, results appear inline.
context.pain: Ad-hoc SQL means copy to a separate client, compile Jinja by hand, run.

render.caption: Query Results — F5 to run, results appear inline. Jinja compiles first. Just works.

context.pitch: One click compiles and runs a whole model — results right there.
context.pain: Seeing a model's output means a full dbt run and a warehouse console.

render.caption: Query Model — one click. Compiles the Jinja, runs it, results right there.

context.pitch: Run a single CTE in isolation and see exactly what it returns.
context.pain: You can't see a CTE's output without hand-editing the query to select it.

render.caption: Query CTE — run one CTE in isolation. Find out what it actually returns.

context.pitch: Row counts and timing per CTE — find the one scanning 40M rows.
context.pain: A slow model gives no clue which CTE is the culprit.

render.caption: Profiler — row counts and timing per CTE. Find which one is scanning 40M rows.

context.pitch: Argument hints inside ref(), source(), and macros as you type.
context.pain: You remember macro signatures or go read the macro.

render.caption: Signature Help — argument hints inside ref(), source(), and macros.

context.pitch: A real debugger for SQL — step CTE by CTE, see each one's rows, step back for free.
context.pain: Debugging dbt SQL is dbt run, read a wall of terminal text, guess, repeat.

render.caption: SQL Debugger — step through each CTE, inspect its rows, step back for free.

context.pitch: dbt tests in VS Code's Testing panel — pass/fail/warn grouped, real errors inline.
context.pain: Test results are buried in dbt's terminal output.

render.caption: Test Explorer — dbt tests in the Testing panel. Pass, fail, warn, grouped.

context.pitch: ~40 SQL style and correctness rules, in-editor, with one-click fixes.
context.pain: Style drift and SQL footguns slip through review.

render.caption: Ninja — ~40 SQL style and correctness rules, right in the editor.
